greeting: Harbor Master Marin on comms. Stage 1: The Silent Harbor. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Depths of Mystery. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I met my future self and we argued about shoe durability.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Prepare deep-sea diving equipment.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Prepare deep-sea diving equipment; Descend to Tide's upper levels; Investigate the silence. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Investigate why Tide has gone silent. Immediate move: Prepare deep-sea diving equipment.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 1 resolved: The Silent Harbor. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Sunken City of Tides.
rumor: Tide monks claim the trench listens when spoken to politely.
People keep repeating one clue from The Silent Harbor: 'Investigate the silence'.
Yesterday a corridor tried to charge me toll in riddles. I paid in sarcasm.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn tide is calm enough for precision dives. Best window for route checks.
dialog.time_noon: Noon currents fight each other in the trench. Anchor and communicate.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk visibility drops fast underwater. Stay on beacon chain.
dialog.time_night: Night tide carries deep-song interference. Confirm orders twice.

party_reactions.kade: Harbor Master Marin sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Harbor Master Marin accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Harbor Master Marin talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: State your objective in one sentence.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Welcome back. What changed since last pass?
relationship_dialog.friend: Good. We move cleaner when we move together.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: No masks, no theater, just us and the objective.
